data.body: Additional FRAC-17 classification: /people still overflows by 6px at simulated touch 360x640. FRAC-17 keeps these exact compact-route cases visible as annotated skips so the new PR gate can protect all other routes/profiles without broadening the Hero ticket.

The 200%-root-font rollout also exposes overflow on Campus (+78px), Political Club (+23px), Library (+292px), and People (+315px) at the 390x844 stress profile. FRAC-17 keeps Home 200% as a hard gate and annotates non-Home stress cases as FRAC-18 follow-up rather than broad-clipping them.
